_comment: Single source of truth for the soundness finite parameters. Rust, Python (tools/verify_soundness_params.py), and Lean (AspisFormal SoundnessParams.lean) must all agree with these values. CI (tools/check_param_binding.py) rejects any disagreement.
_derivation: alpha = (1 + 1/(2*johnson_multiplicity)) * sqrt(1/rate_inverse); agreement_cap = floor(alpha * johnson_fiber_count). With multiplicity 10 the slack is 1 + 1/20 = 21/20.
